journey.title: Tab out of the departure date to the passengers field
journey.goal: Tab moves focus from the date field to the next field, as in any form

functionalJourney.title: Change the passengers with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Editing another field and saving submits the saved departure date

guards.title: Escape still closes the calendar
guards.goal: With the calendar open, Escape closes it and Tab then reaches the passengers field

attempts.failure: Invalid proposal schema: edits: Invalid input: expected array, received undefined

plan.root_cause: The Vanilla Calendar Pro (VCP) calendar, when initialized with `inputMode: true` for popup datepickers, attaches a keydown listener to the input that calls `preventDefault()` on Tab, blocking default focus movement to the next form field.
plan.repair_strategy: Register a keydown listener on the input before the VCP calendar is created. This listener detects Tab, calls `stopImmediatePropagation()` to prevent VCP's handler from running, hides the calendar if open, and allows the browser's default Tab behavior to proceed.

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key now correctly moves focus from the departure date field to the passengers field, restoring standard keyboard navigation order per WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3.
functional_risks: If VCP's keydown handler handles other keys (arrows, Enter, Escape), they still work because stopImmediatePropagation is only called for Tab.
Calendar hides on Tab press, which is desired behavior for exiting a popup.
verification_requirements: Tab from departure date moves focus to passengers field
Arrow keys still navigate within calendar when open
